svg.metadata: {"format": "takt-chart-key/1", "class": "takt-timeline", "title": "Scenario 1: takt runs to the merge approval, by takt revision", "legend": [[{"mark": "<circle cx=\"7\" cy=\"7\" r=\"5\" class=\"acc\"/>", "text": "tokens, one run (rN: it needed N resumes; unlabelled: none; bar: median)"}, {"mark": "<rect x=\"3\" y=\"3\" width=\"8\" height=\"8\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"#8a9a95\" stroke-width=\"1.6\"/>", "text": "wall time, one run (right axis)"}, {"mark": "<path d=\"M3,3L11,11M3,11L11,3\" stroke=\"#8a9a95\" stroke-width=\"1.8\"/>", "text": "refused before the first step, no tokens"}, {"mark": "<circle cx=\"7\" cy=\"7\" r=\"4\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"#8a9a95\" stroke-width=\"1.5\"/>", "text": "no figure stated"}, {"mark": "<path d=\"M7,1L13,7L7,13L1,7Z\" class=\"acc\" fill-opacity=\"0.25\" stroke-width=\"1.8\"/>", "text": "tokens, one run of a candidate revision of an improvement turn"}, {"mark": "<rect x=\"2.5\" y=\"2.5\" width=\"9\" height=\"9\" class=\"acc\"/>", "text": "a dated event, after the last column dated before it"}]], "notes": [{"lead": "turn-1", "text": " (solid line): scenario-run-help-exit-codes; reproduced at 0a776d2; not_reproduced at 447423c; scorecard: no_regression, median tokens +24% (n=3); merged at 67ab6ce; promoted at a0b8576; outcome: accepted"}, {"lead": "turn-2", "text": " (solid line): case-id-is-a-valid-branch-name; reproduced at a0b8576; not_reproduced at 98719c3; scorecard: no_regression, median tokens +0% (n=5); merged at 0cb62c0; promoted at 44f96a4; outcome: accepted"}, {"lead": "turn-3", "text": " (solid line): hours-bounds-a-harness-step; reproduced at a0b8576; not_reproduced at 9fb14cc; scorecard: no_regression, median tokens -0% (n=5); merged at 76be9ed; promoted at 44f96a4; outcome: accepted"}, {"lead": "first turn accepted by validators", "text": " (dashed line, square), 2026-10-19: self-improvement trial 2 drove a self.improvement/1 turn to accepted with its candidate promoted, every claim recorded by a validator (takt 71f061c on impl/rsi-part-2); trials 3 and 4 did it again at 7a4d6b9 and 30bd2f0. In scratch: a scratch promotion store and install root, --forge none, main fast-forwarded by the operator. The installed takt has not yet promoted a revision through a turn."}, {"lead": "first turn promoted by the installed takt", "text": " (dashed line, square), 2026-10-19: self.improvement/1 turn takt-20261019T180323Z reached accepted in 17 min 36 s, every invocation judged by the installed, promoted takt 0.2.3 (78c1a08e), the last by the copy takt promote kept as the judge. Finding story:scorecard-help-names-the-held-out-check; candidate 7ae5b05b (on main as 262bfa32 since its history was rewritten to the bot identity), written by a delivery run of the installed takt that stopped on NoProgress, its two commits cherry-picked onto the turn's base by the operator. Six records, each by a validator. The installed takt promoted 7ae5b05b into its real promotion store: a record of kind promotion against 78c1a08e, 0 scenarios worse, n=5 runs a side. A human granted only the judge-surface merge and the promote."}, {"text": "Data: 2026-10-18 (UTC), docs/metrics/scenario-runs.jsonl, 57 runs. One scenario, n per revision in the rows under the axis: first results, not a benchmark. Untimed revisions have no wall time; tokens are summed over the invocations that reached the merge approval, resumes included. Events: docs/metrics/events.jsonl, each with its run record.", "muted": true}]}

turn-1 (solid line): scenario-run-help-exit-codes; reproduced at 0a776d2; not_reproduced at 447423c; scorecard: no_regression, median
tokens +24% (n=3); merged at 67ab6ce; promoted at a0b8576; outcome: accepted
turn-2 (solid line): case-id-is-a-valid-branch-name; reproduced at a0b8576; not_reproduced at 98719c3; scorecard: no_regression, median
tokens +0% (n=5); merged at 0cb62c0; promoted at 44f96a4; outcome: accepted
turn-3 (solid line): hours-bounds-a-harness-step; reproduced at a0b8576; not_reproduced at 9fb14cc; scorecard: no_regression, median
tokens -0% (n=5); merged at 76be9ed; promoted at 44f96a4; outcome: accepted
first turn accepted by validators (dashed line, square), 2026-10-19: self-improvement trial 2 drove a self.improvement/1 turn to accepted
with its candidate promoted, every claim recorded by a validator (takt 71f061c on impl/rsi-part-2); trials 3 and 4 did it again at 7a4d6b9 and
30bd2f0. In scratch: a scratch promotion store and install root, --forge none, main fast-forwarded by the operator. The installed takt
has not yet promoted a revision through a turn.
first turn promoted by the installed takt (dashed line, square), 2026-10-19: self.improvement/1 turn takt-20261019T180323Z reached
accepted in 17 min 36 s, every invocation judged by the installed, promoted takt 0.2.3 (78c1a08e), the last by the copy takt promote kept as
the judge. Finding story:scorecard-help-names-the-held-out-check; candidate 7ae5b05b (on main as 262bfa32 since its history was
rewritten to the bot identity), written by a delivery run of the installed takt that stopped on NoProgress, its two commits cherry-picked
onto the turn's base by the operator. Six records, each by a validator. The installed takt promoted 7ae5b05b into its real promotion store:
a record of kind promotion against 78c1a08e, 0 scenarios worse, n=5 runs a side. A human granted only the judge-surface merge and the
promote.
Data: 2026-10-18 (UTC), docs/metrics/scenario-runs.jsonl, 57 runs. One scenario, n per revision in the rows under the axis: first results,
not a benchmark. Untimed revisions have no wall time; tokens are summed over the invocations that reached the merge approval, resumes
included. Events: docs/metrics/events.jsonl, each with its run record.
